info.title: IDC 2D Modeler - AI Agent Design Command API
info.description:
Lets an AI agent () drive the IDC 2D survey/modeling tool through natural-language conversation: every command is executed **inside the user's open editor page**, the canvas updates live, and all domain rules (auto numbering / collision push-aside / aisle-width linkage) behave exactly as manual editing.

## Usage flow
1. Call `GET /api/agent/status` first and make sure `connected=true` **and `pages=1`** (exactly one editor page open). Since v1.1.1 every command batch is pinned to the single most-recently-active page, so multiple pages can no longer split a batch — but if `pages>1` still ask the user to close extra editor tabs to avoid working on the wrong page.
2. Call design commands **one at a time, in order** (wait for each response before sending the next). Typical sequence: project.new (or project.open to resume a saved project) → room.rect / wall.add → pod.create/row.create → obj.add (AC/UPS/RPP/cable tray) → opening.add (doors/windows) → query.status / query.checks self-check → project.save.
3. For change requests use obj.update/obj.updateBatch/obj.move/obj.delete/obj.rotate; when the user says "undo", call project.undo.

## Domain rules (must follow)
- **All units are millimeters (mm)**. Coordinate system: origin (0,0) = inner wall surface at the room's south-west corner; X axis points east, Y axis points north.
- Standard cabinet: 600×1200×2000mm (W×D×H); 800mm-wide variant exists. Front orientation is set by rotation (0=front faces north, 90=east, 180=south, 270=west).
- **Aisle POD rules**: cold aisle = two rows facing each other (front-to-front); hot aisle = two rows back-to-back. Cold/hot aisles always alternate inside a POD; only the aisle type selected via firstAisle is enclosed. Defaults: cold aisle 1200mm, hot aisle 900mm.
- Naming template: `#` = sequence slot (count = minimum digits); the letter group right before `#` = row letter, e.g. `A##`→A01, `101-A##`. The row letter auto-increments after each placement.
- Each command = one undo step (obj.updateBatch changes many objects but is still ONE undo step). Out-of-range parameters or placements outside the room return a Chinese error message (ok=false); relay `message` to the user, fix parameters, and retry.
- Any command may include `"shot": true` to get a canvas screenshot (PNG dataURL) in the response, useful for showing the user.
- Note: runtime error messages are returned in Chinese by design (relay them to the end user as-is).
- **Omitted parameters follow the editor's last-used values** (identical to manual modelling): the `default` in a schema is the FACTORY value only. After the user changes something in the property panel, room.rect/wall.add (thickness/height/material), opening.add (width/leaf/side/swing/sill/kind), obj.add (rect sizes + props, tray width/height/kind, beam b/h/top/concrete/kind) and pod.create/row.create (cabinet electrical props, aisle props enclosed/endDoors/doorType/doorW) inherit that value. Pass the key explicitly whenever exact geometry matters (clearance / feasibility math).
- **Room-level info (`meta`)** is written through project.save `meta` (string or number values, merged into the project and persisted). Keys: surveyor, date, site (campus/building), roomHeight (structural clear height, mm), ceilHeight (ceiling face height, mm; empty/0/>=roomHeight = open ceiling), floorHeight (raised-floor plenum height, mm), tier (A|B|C per GB 50174), powerCap (total power capacity, kW), powerModule (power module capacity, kVA), floorLoad (floor load, kg/m2), coolArch (风冷直膨|冷冻水|双冷源|其他), climate (temp/humidity requirement), remark. query.checks reads roomHeight/ceilHeight/floorHeight for the civil rules and powerCap/floorLoad for the power / floor-load rules — set them before the self-check when the survey data is known.
- **Command names are exactly the dot-notation names in this contract's `paths`** — there is no `xxx.create` / `xxx.add` command other than `room.rect`, `wall.add`, `pod.create`, `row.create`, `obj.add` and `opening.add`. Single objects (AC/UPS/battery/extinguisher/floor vent/RPP/distribution box/cabinet) and cable trays are added with `obj.add` + `type`: object types are **values of the `type` field, not tool names** (so `ac.create`, `cabinet.create`, `空调.create` … do not exist). A name outside this list returns `code: UNKNOWN_TOOL` with the complete legal name list in the Chinese `message` — pick a name from it and re-issue; never repeat the wrong name (ok=false codes can be relayed to the model to self-repair).

## props field reference (by object type, for obj.add / obj.update / obj.updateBatch / cabinetProps)
- **Common equipment fields** (cabinet, pdu, dbox, ups, battery, ac, extinguisher, vent): top-level `z` is the equipment base elevation in signed mm above finished floor (default 0; use obj.add/obj.update/obj.updateBatch; never props.z). `props.color` accepts #rgb/#rrggbb or '' for the type default; both 2D and 3D use it. Query summaries include z and color. XY moves/rotation/copies preserve z; new equipment starts at 0. Pipe geometry retains z1/z2; architectural height/sill/top fields are unchanged.
- **cabinet**: w, d, h, u (rack units, 42), power (kW, 4 for 600-wide / 6 for 800-wide), rpdu (count, 2), voltage (220|380), current (16|32|63), sockets: [{type, count}] where type ∈ `IEC C13` | `IEC C19` | `国标10A`=CN-standard 10A | `国标16A`=CN-standard 16A | `工业连接器16A`=industrial 16A | `工业连接器32A`=industrial 32A, wireSize (e.g. `5×10mm²`), color (cabinet color as `#rrggbb`; `''` = theme default, rendered in both 2D and 3D), remark
- **ac** (precision AC): w(2500), d(1300), h(2800), cool (kW, 25), air (m³/h, 2800), temp (°C supply air, 18), supply ∈ `水平送风`=horizontal | `下送风`=downflow | `上送风`=upflow | `侧送风`=side, acType ∈ `房间级精密空调`=room-level | `行级（列间）空调`=in-row | `机柜级（背板）空调`=cabinet/rear-door | `远端风墙空调`=fan-wall (far end) | `近端风墙空调`=fan-wall (near end) | `其他`=other, redundancy ∈ `N+0` | `N+1` | `N+2`, ctrlMode ∈ `送风控制`=supply-air | `回风控制`=return-air, supplyRh (%RH), returnTemp (°C), remark
- **ups** (uninterruptible power supply): w(800), d(800), h(2000), kva (rated capacity in kVA, 200), power (output power in kW, 160), voltage (220|380, default 380), current (63|100|160|250|400|630, default 400), backup (battery autonomy in minutes, 15), upsType ∈ `工频机`=line-frequency (transformer-based) | `高频机`=high-frequency | `模块化`=modular | `机架式`=rack-mounted | `其他`=other, redundancy ∈ N+0 | N+1 | N+2, remark
- **battery** (UPS battery cabinet): w(800), d(800), h(2000), batType ∈ `阀控铅酸`=VRLA lead-acid | `胶体`=gel | `磷酸铁锂`=LiFePO4 lithium | `其他`=other, ah (single cell capacity in Ah, 100), cells (cell count, 32), voltage (string voltage in V, 384), remark
- **extinguisher** (fire extinguisher): w(400), d(400), h(1200), extType ∈ `手提式干粉`=portable dry-powder | `手提式二氧化碳`=portable CO2 | `推车式干粉`=wheeled dry-powder | `悬挂式气体`=hanging gas | `其他`=other, kg (charge weight in kg, 5), remark
- **pdu** (RPP / power head cabinet): w(600), d(1200), h(2000), voltage (220|380, default 380), current (63|100|160|250|400|630, default 250), outCircuits (free text, e.g. `12路40A/3P + 4路32A/1P` (12 ways 40A/3P + 4 ways 32A/1P)), remark
- **dbox** (distribution box): w(600), d(200), h(800), boxUse ∈ `动力配电` | `照明配电` | `综合配电` | `其他` (power/lighting/general/other); mounting ∈ `壁挂明装` | `嵌入暗装` | `落地安装` (wall/recessed/floor); voltage(V,380), current(A,100), outCircuits(text), remark. No wall snapping/openings; set base z explicitly.
- **vent** (floor outlet): w(600), d(600), kind ∈ `格栅` (grille) | `孔板` (perforated), air (m³/h, 1000), remark
- **column**: w(800), d(800), h(3000)
- **aisle** (auto-created by pod.create): kind ∈ cold | hot, w (aisle length), d (aisle width — changing it auto-shifts linked rows), h, enclosed (bool), endDoors ∈ both | one | none (doors at enclosed aisle ends; one = local start end only, rotate 180° to swap; none = fixed panels), doorType ∈ sliding | double | single (sliding = no swing clearance; swing doors open outward), doorW (clear door width, 0 = full aisle width; narrower openings are centered with fixed sidelights)
- **tray**: width(300), height (above floor, 2500), bodyH(100), kind ∈ `强电`=power | `弱电`=low-voltage/data | `光纤`=fiber, structure ∈ `ABS光纤槽`=ABS-fiber-duct | `网格桥架`=wire-mesh-tray | `梯架`=ladder-rack | `金属线槽`=metal-trunking
- **door**: width(1500), height(2700), leaf ∈ single | double, side ∈ out | in, swing ∈ left | right (single-leaf only)
- **window**: width(1500), height(1500), sill(900)
- **grille** (wall louver): width(2500), height(2750), sill(10), kind ∈ `送风` (supply) | `回风` (return)
- **wall**: thickness(240), height(3000), material ∈ `砖墙`=brick | `混凝土`=concrete | `轻钢龙骨`=steel-stud | `玻璃隔断`=glass-partition
- **beam** (frame beam drawn between columns): b (section width mm, 300), h (section height mm, 600), top (top elevation above floor mm, 3000 — defaults to the taller attached column), concrete ∈ C25|C30|C35|C40|C45|C50 (C30), kind ∈ `框架梁`=frame (default) | `次梁`=secondary | `悬挑梁`=cantilever, remark. Endpoints x1,y1 → x2,y2 snap to column centres and keep following the columns; obj.move on a beam detaches both ends.
- **pipe** (liquid-cooling straight segment): geometry is top-level x1,y1,z1,x2,y2,z2 (signed centre elevations above finished floor; XY-coincident points = riser); systemId/circuitId/pairId are associations, NOT topology. props: nominalSize (text, e.g. `DN50`), outsideDiameter (actual outer diameter mm, 60.3 — NOT DN), wallThickness (null, or 0 < 2t < OD; 2), insulationThickness (>= 0; 0), material (text, `stainless-steel-304`), color (`#rgb`/`#rrggbb` or '' = automatic), side ∈ supply | return, loopSide ∈ primary | secondary, flowDirection ∈ forward | reverse | none, remark. One straight segment per object — no fittings, topology, hydraulics or platform pipe import.
- **Editor pages & routing**: each editor page registers a persistent clientId via long-poll; commands are delivered ONLY to the sticky active page (last page that completed a command; fails over after ~8s offline). `status.clients` lists online pages with `active` flags.
- **Retry semantics**: commands are executed exactly once per delivery, but they are NOT idempotent. `EXEC_TIMEOUT` means the page may have already executed the command while its result was lost — ALWAYS verify with query.objects before retrying, or you may create duplicates. `EDITOR_OFFLINE` is safe to retry freely (command never left the queue).
- **Wall ids stay valid**: opening.add does NOT split the host wall — wall ids returned by room.rect / wall.add remain usable for any number of openings. Keep the ids from creation responses; no re-query needed.
- Default command timeout is 60s (env AGENT_CMD_TIMEOUT, ms); keep batches sequential.

get.summary: Check editor page connection (probe before sending commands)

200.description: connected=true means an editor page is open and ready; queued = commands waiting for the page; inflight = commands picked but not yet done; pages = online editor pages (must be 1 before a batch); clients = per-page detail {id, active, bg, agoMs}

pinned.description: true = a page was explicitly claimed via POST /api/agent/claim and commands stay pinned to it until it goes offline

post.summary: Start a new blank project (clears the canvas; guarded against wiping unsaved work)
post.description: If the current project already has objects, the call fails with code NOT_EMPTY unless force=true — save first (project.save) or confirm with the user, then retry with force:true.

post.summary: Open a project previously saved on the server (resume after page reload)
post.description: Guarded: if the current project has UNSAVED changes, fails with NOT_EMPTY unless force=true. Use project.list to discover names.

post.summary: List projects saved on the server
Save the project on the server (user can reopen it in the editor for manual refinement)
Export the design as DXF drawing or CSV bill-of-quantities text (same builders as the editor UI)

200.description: Execution result (result.content = file text, result.filename = suggested name)

post.summary: Undo one step (shares the user's Ctrl+Z undo stack)
Redo one step
Create a rectangular room (4 walls) by inner dimensions, with optional offset
post.description: Wall centerlines are offset outward by half the thickness, so the inner clear size equals the input. Returns 4 wall ids (south→east→north→west) for opening.add. Use x0/y0 to place sub-areas or multiple rooms.

post.summary: Draw a free wall segment (partition, air-wall, irregular room, aisle end-cap wall)
post.description: Segment by endpoints x1,y1 → x2,y2. Combine several calls for polygon rooms; cut doors into end-cap walls with opening.add (standard practice for enclosed cold aisles).

post.summary: Batch-create a cabinet POD with aisles (cold=front-to-front, hot=back-to-back, alternating, aisle bands auto-generated)
post.description: x,y = center of the first cabinet in the first row. Cold/hot aisle bands are auto-created (only the firstAisle type enclosed) with auto-incrementing names from tpl. Overlapping existing objects are pushed aside automatically. cabinetProps applies per-cabinet properties (power, voltage, sockets...) to all generated cabinets in the same undo step.

post.summary: Place a single row of cabinets
post.description: x,y = center of the first cabinet. The row extends along the axis facing the cabinets' side (rotation=0/180 → along X, 90/270 → along Y). cabinetProps applies per-cabinet properties to the whole row.

post.summary: Place one object: column / AC / UPS / battery / fire extinguisher / floor vent / RPP (pdu) / distribution box (dbox) / cabinet, or draw a cable-tray segment
post.description: column/ac/ups/battery/extinguisher/vent/pdu/dbox/cabinet take center x,y; tray/beam take x1,y1,x2,y2. pipe takes top-level x1,y1,z1,x2,y2,z2 with no x/y midpoint (spec fields and props: see the **pipe** entry of the props field reference; a 4m plan + 3m rise pipe has a 5m centreline length). name works for all types.

post.summary: Cut a door / window / grille opening into a wall
post.description: wallId comes from room.rect/wall.add results; t = opening center position along the wall (0=wall start, 1=wall end). Move an existing opening later with obj.update {id, t}.

post.summary: Update object properties; move wall-openings along their wall via t; aisle d change auto-shifts linked rows
Update many objects at once (by ids or selector), as ONE undo step
post.description: Targets: explicit ids array OR selector {type, name} (name = prefix match, e.g. "A" matches A01..A12). Example: set power=6 on all cabinets via selector {type:"cabinet"}. Aisle width changes link row-by-row within the same undo step.

post.summary: Move objects by delta (walls/trays move both endpoints; wall-mounted openings follow their wall; overlaps pushed aside)
Delete objects (deleting a wall cascades to its doors/windows/grilles)
Rotate objects 90° (cabinet/column/ac/ups/battery/extinguisher/vent/pdu/dbox/pipe only)
post.description: Rotating a pipe rotates its plan geometry 90° about its own centre (z1/z2 unchanged); beams/trays/walls/aisles are not rotatable — redraw or move them instead. Other types are rejected with NOT_FOUND and a Chinese hint listing the rotatable types.

post.summary: Compliance self-check: object counts / total power / overlap scan / out-of-room check, with a Chinese report

Rule-based compliance self-check: clearance / power / cooling / fire-safety / floor-load / room-height rules → structured issue list (level, rule, cat, msg, actual vs expected, location, involved object ids). Typical loop: run after design, fix issues with obj.move/obj.update, re-run until clean.
post.description: Thresholds come from the editor's persisted config; pass optional `cfg` to override for this run only, e.g. {"cabFront": 1000, "disabled": ["density"]}. Known numeric keys: cabFront(900), cabRear(600), cabSideWall(600), coldAisle(1200), hotAisle(900), acService(900), trayMinHeight(2200), trayAboveCab(300), upsLoadMaxPct(85), coolMinRatio(1.0), densityKW(10), densityArea(1.2), doorMinWidth(900), twoExitArea(100 m²), extRadius(15000), extGrid(500), floorLoadWarnPct(80), clearHeightMin(2400), underfloorMin(400), plus weight-estimation coefficients kgPerCabKW/kgPerUpsKVA/kgPerAhCell/kgPerAC/kgPerPDU. Unknown keys are ignored. Issue level ∈ error|warn|info; cat ∈ layout|clearance|power|cooling|fire|load|civil. Rule ids (use in cfg.disabled): acFront, aisleW, cabAB, cabFront, cabRear, cabSideWall, coolCap, density, doorW, enclosed, exits, extCover, floorLoad, height, outRoom, overlap, pduCap, pipes, pwrCap, trayH, upsLoad. Meta fields powerCap/floorLoad/roomHeight/ceilHeight/floorHeight should be set via project.save meta (power, floor-load and civil rules read them; defaults are used when absent).

cfg.description: Optional per-run threshold overrides (numeric keys) plus disabled: string[] of rule ids to skip

200.description: Execution result (result.summary = {error,warn,info,total}; result.issues = up to 200 structured issues, Chinese msg)

post.summary: List objects (compact: id/type/name/position), filterable by type and name substring
post.description: Use this to collect ids for update/move/delete instead of reading saved files. Returns up to 1000 entries.

post.summary: Get one object's full data (all props)
Capture the canvas (PNG dataURL); optionally zoom to one object first via focusId

ObjSummary.description: Compact object summary — the shape of result.added (objects created by a command) and result.objects (query.objects). Positions are the REAL rounded coordinates in mm after collision push-aside / numbering: never re-derive geometry from the arguments you sent.

rotation.description: 0 = front faces north, 90 = east, 180 = south, 270 = west

x1.description: Start point X in mm (walls, cable trays, beams — instead of x/y/rotation)

y1.description: Start point Y in mm (walls, cable trays, beams)

x2.description: End point X in mm (walls, cable trays, beams)

y2.description: End point Y in mm (walls, cable trays, beams)

z.description: Equipment base elevation in signed mm (cabinet/pdu/dbox/ups/battery/ac/extinguisher/vent only)

color.description: Equipment colour `#rrggbb`; empty = type default (equipment only)

z1.description: Pipe start centre elevation, signed mm

z2.description: Pipe end centre elevation, signed mm

length.description: Pipe 3D centreline length in mm (includes the vertical rise)

props.description: Pipe spec object (nominalSize / outsideDiameter / wallThickness / insulationThickness / material / colour / side / loopSide / flowDirection / remark); full props via obj.get for other types

ok.description: true = success; false = failure, see code + message (Chinese, relay to user as-is)

code.description: Error code: EDITOR_OFFLINE = no editor page connected; BAD_PARAM / OUT_OF_ROOM / NOT_FOUND / NOT_EMPTY / ... = parameter or state problem

added.description: Objects created by this command, with their real position (mm, rounded) — same shape as query.objects entries. Keep ids for later update/move/delete and use the coordinates for feasibility checks instead of re-deriving them from earlier arguments.

shot.description: Canvas screenshot PNG dataURL (when request had shot:true)

objects.description: query.objects result: compact list (equipment entries carry z + color, pipes carry z1/z2/systemId/circuitId/pairId/length/props)

name.description: project.new / project.save / project.open result: the project name now in use

overlaps.description: query.status result: number of overlapping solid-object pairs (should be 0)

outOfRoom.description: query.status result: number of solids outside the room wall bounding box (should be 0)

summary.description: query.checks result: issue count per level

issues.description: query.checks result (max 200): fix with obj.move / obj.update / obj.updateBatch, then re-run until empty

rule.description: Rule id, e.g. cabFront / coldAisle / floorLoad / pipes (pass it in cfg.disabled to skip that rule)

msg.description: Chinese message with measured vs expected values (relay as-is)

actual.description: Measured value as a display string

expect.description: Required value as a display string

objectIds.description: Involved objects — operate on these ids to fix the issue

name.description: New project name; defaults to the localized "untitled"

force.description: true = discard the current project's content even when it has objects

name.description: Project name on the server (see project.list)

force.description: true = discard unsaved changes in the current project

name.description: Project name (Chinese/English letters, digits, _ -, 1-64 chars); defaults to the current project name

meta.description: Room-level info, merged into project.meta (string or number values only). Keys: surveyor, date, site, roomHeight (structural clear height mm), ceilHeight (ceiling face height mm), floorHeight (raised-floor plenum height mm), tier (A|B|C), powerCap (kW), powerModule (kVA), floorLoad (kg/m2), coolArch, climate, remark. query.checks consumes roomHeight/ceilHeight/floorHeight (civil rules) and powerCap/floorLoad (power / floor-load rules) — see the meta bullet in the domain rules.

kind.description: dxf = CAD drawing (R12, 1:1 mm); csv = bill of quantities (summary + per-device detail, Chinese)

material.description: Wall material (Chinese data key): 砖墙=brick/panel 混凝土=concrete 轻钢龙骨=stud 玻璃隔断=glass

x0.description: X of the room's south-west inner corner (offset for sub-areas)

y0.description: Y of the room's south-west inner corner

shot.description: true = include a canvas screenshot in the response

rows.description: Number of cabinet rows (>=2, grouped as aisle POD)

gap.description: Gap between cabinets within a row, mm

firstAisle.description: Type of the first aisle (between rows 1-2); this type gets enclosed

axis.description: Layout axis: x = rows run east-west, stacking northward; y = the other way

x.description: Center X of the first cabinet in the first row (mm from west)

y.description: Center Y of the first cabinet in the first row (mm from south)

tpl.description: Naming template: # = sequence slot, preceding letter group = row letter, e.g. A##, 101-A##

cabinetProps.description: Per-cabinet props applied to ALL generated cabinets (power, voltage, current, rpdu, sockets, u, h, remark...). w/d ignored (layout-controlled). See props field reference.

x.description: Center X of the first cabinet (mm from west)

y.description: Center Y of the first cabinet (mm from south)

tpl.description: Naming template, e.g. F##; defaults to the next free row letter

cabinetProps.description: Per-cabinet props applied to the whole row (w/d ignored). See props field reference.

type.description: column=pillar ac=precision AC ups=uninterruptible power supply battery=battery cabinet (UPS batteries) extinguisher=fire extinguisher vent=floor outlet pdu=RPP/power head cabinet dbox=distribution box (600x200x800; use/mounting/voltage/current/outCircuits) tray=cable tray beam=frame beam between columns (endpoints snap to column centers and follow columns)

z.description: Equipment base elevation above finished floor, signed mm (cabinet/pdu/dbox/ups/battery/ac/extinguisher/vent only); not props.z

z1.description: pipe start centre elevation (mm), signed; finished floor Z=0; required for pipe

z2.description: pipe end centre elevation (mm), signed; required for pipe; XY-coincident risers are valid

height.description: tray mounting height above floor, mm

kind.description: tray type: 强电=power 弱电=low-voltage/data 光纤=fiber; beam type: 框架梁(default)=frame beam 次梁=secondary beam 悬挑梁=cantilever (Chinese data keys)

top.description: beam top elevation above floor mm (defaults to the taller of the two attached columns)

name.description: Custom name/number for ALL types including tray (auto-assigned if omitted)

props.description: Property overrides — see the props field reference in API info (cabinet power/u/sockets, AC cool/supply/acType, pdu voltage/current, dbox boxUse/mounting/voltage/current/outCircuits, ups kva/backup...)

wallId.description: Target wall id (from room.rect / wall.add result)

t.description: Opening center along wall: 0 = wall start, 1 = wall end

width.description: Opening width mm (defaults: door 1500, window 1500, grille 2500)

props.description: Overrides: door leaf(single/double)/side(in/out)/swing, window sill, grille kind(送风=supply/回风=return)/height/sill

z.description: Equipment base elevation above finished floor (signed mm); equipment only, not props.z

z1.description: pipe start centre elevation, signed mm

z2.description: pipe end centre elevation, signed mm

props.description: Partial property update. Pipe geometry is top-level, not props. Pipe updates/batches validate atomically before recording undo; use actual OD rather than nominal DN. Changing an aisle band's d (aisle width mm) auto-shifts the linked cabinet rows.

t.description: Wall-attached openings only (door/window/grille): move along the wall, 0 = wall start, 1 = wall end

z.description: Set base elevation for every target (equipment only). A mixed equipment/architectural/pipe selection is rejected atomically.

ids.description: Explicit target ids (use this OR selector)

type.description: Object type, e.g. ac / ups / cabinet

name.description: Name PREFIX match, e.g. "A" matches A01..A12

selector.description: Select targets by type and/or name prefix

props.description: Partial property update applied to every target. Aisle d changes link rows one by one, all in ONE undo step.

name.description: Filter by name substring (e.g. "A0" matches A01..A09)

fit.description: true = zoom to fit all content before capturing (ignored when focusId is set)

focusId.description: Object id: zoom to this object (with margin) before capturing, to verify a specific spot
